name: Anycubic Kobra Max 0.4 nozzle
pre_gcode: M104 S140;start the nozzle preheat and don't wait
M190 S{bed_temp} ; set wait for bed temp
M355 S1;turn on the case light
M109 S{temp}; wait for extruder temp
G1 Z15.0 F1000 ;move the nozzle up 15mm
G1 F100 E60;extrude 60mm of feed stock
G92 E0;zero the extruded length again
post_gcode: M140 S0;heated bed heater off (if you have it)
G1 Z+10 F3600 ;move Z up a bit
G1 X10 F3000; get the head off the bed
G1 F3000 Y400 ;kick the bed out
M355 S0;turn off the case light
fan_gcode: M106 S{fan_speed}  ; p3d: add for orca slicer
